series.name: Signal
series.description: Confident orange. Large type. A product you can see at a glance.
series.intent: The strongest category thumbnail: bold benefits and large, deliberately cropped devices.

series.name: Editorial
series.description: Quiet confidence. Precise type. An off-centre product story.
series.intent: A more premium, understated direction. White space frames the UI rather than shrinking it.

series.name: Postcard
series.description: A place you want to be. A connection to take with you.
series.intent: Travel atmosphere leads; the app stays tangible. Original illustrative photography, not destination promises.

series.name: Product focus
series.description: Closer to the product. One useful detail on each screen.
series.intent: Oversized, honest crops of the supplied interface. Best for judging what the product actually explains.

series.name: After hours
series.description: Deep charcoal. Warm orange. A sharply framed interface.
series.intent: A darker, high-contrast system with a framed product stage and punchier type hierarchy.
